column1: Decision workbook · product boundary, reference coverage, research findings, and launch choices
Every message uses an explicit route: transport + local identity + remote identity. No silent fallback.
Gradual pacing can be an operational safeguard, but no controlled public evidence was found that synthetic SIM-to-SIM traffic creates carrier trust.
